pages.lesson:
LESSON: INTONATION IN SENTENCES: QUESTION TAGS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.1.1: Intonation in sentences: Question tags

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Intonation in sentences: Question tags
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can we improve our speaking skills?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. write the correct form of question tags in sentences
2. apply question tags appropriately in communication
3. compose sentences using question tags correctly
4. appreciate the importance of question tags and correct intonation in communication

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Intonation in sentences: Question tags

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Intonation in sentences: Question tags

Teach
• Focus skill: write the correct form of question tags in sentences.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Intonation in sentences: Question tags.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Intonation in sentences: Question tags
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we improve our speaking skills?
2. Why do we use question tags in speech?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
